in_marathi.name: Hemonta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wealth and prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hemonta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hemonta is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Hema’, which means ‘Goddess of wealth and prosperity’. This name is considered auspicious and is believed to bring abundance, prosperity, and good fortune. In Hindu mythology, Hemonta is a form of Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, who is worshipped for her blessings of wealth, fortune, and prosperity.
